title: Wanting to leave NBC; summoned by the conductor
summary: Budd does not want to be a writing machine and is called in by Jerry Jerome before a break in the taping.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: know, I don't know if I want this job, I don't think I want this job because, I mean, I don't get a chance to play my horn no more, this is consuming all my time, and you know, just to sit up and write, write, write and write and write, and become like a machine, I don't think I want to do this.

So while I'm making up my mind I went down one day to pick up my pay check and when I went to the office, you know, the guy said, 'oh, the conductor want to speak to you.' I said, oh, hell, it's going to hit the fan any way, I said, because it must be about that organ, you know. And I've never made a rehearsal, you know. I'd send in -- I'd give him my music, the copies, and I'm going on about my business. I have never yet heard a rehearsal or caught a show on the air. You know, this is what I was -- you know, so that sounds a little unusual but I mean I'm trying to get a few other things, you know?
And I figured, well the music's got to be halfway right, you know.
Hey, let's take a little break for a second, Budd.
Okay, Budd, go ahead with what you were bringing out.
